description: Set the value of a writable Jotai atom (by label, from get_jotai_state). Read-only/derived atoms cannot be set (you'll get a clear error). Use for tweaking state during debugging.

atom.description: Atom label to set (from get_jotai_state; must be writable).

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

value.description: The new value (any JSON — number, string, object, etc.).

name: jotai_action
